name: P. D. Cravath
role: Minneapolis visitor and the editor's companion to the Black Hills
bio: P. D. Cravath of Minneapolis, an old college friend of the Cow Boy's editor, set out with him for the Black Hills at the end of June 1884. The paper calls him both a representative of the Globe Oil Works and a correspondent of the Minneapolis Tribune.

moments.label: Joined the editor's camping trip to the Black Hills

mentions: P. D. Cravath, representing the Globe Oil Works, Minneapolis, was a visitor in our town on Sunday and left for Deadwood via the Medora route on Monday afternoon.
